{{Quote|I haven't seen another Kiffar for years. Were you on Kiffu during the Annexation?|[[Larin Moxla]], to [[Shigar Konshi]]|<ref name="FA" />}}
The '''Annexation of Kiffu''' was a conflict after [[3653 BBY]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] in which the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] forcibly took control of the [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] homeworld of [[Kiffu/Legends|Kiffu]].

==The conflict==
After the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] annexation, many [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] escaped into [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] space, some to join the Republic in liberating their world. After the war, [[Kiffu/Legends|Kiffu]] became part of the Republic.

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Think of your homeworld and all who died there. Tell yourself that I killed them, and seek the strength that knowledge brings.''"<br />"''You had nothing to do with Kiffu.''"<br />"''Didn't I?|Darth Chratis and Shigar Konshi|<ref name="FA" />}}
It is implied through dialogue in ''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]'' that [[Darth Chratis]] played some role in the annexation of Kiffu. However, this has never been confirmed, and the context of the dialogue itself makes its reliability questionable. Darth Chratis claims to [[Shigar Konshi]] that his anger toward Chratis for the subjugation gives him power, and when Konshi replies that this is false, as Chratis played no part in the annexation, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] simply replies "Didn't I?" However, Chratis may have been lying in order to further encourage Konshi's anger and so lure him down the path of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="FA" />
